questions.content:
Speaking — Part 1 - Personal information

What is the weather like today, and what do you usually do in this kind of weather?
questions.sampleAnswer: Today it is very hot and sunny. In this weather, I usually stay at home. I like to drink cold water and watch TV. Sometimes, I go swimming with my friends in the afternoon because it helps me cool down.

questions.content:
Speaking — Part 1 - Personal information

What is your favourite kind of weather or season, and why?
questions.sampleAnswer: My favourite season is autumn because the weather is cool and windy. I love autumn because the trees look beautiful with yellow leaves. I can walk in the park with my family and we can take many nice photos together.

questions.content:
Speaking — Part 1 - Personal information

What do you usually do at the weekend?
questions.sampleAnswer: At the weekend, I usually sleep in because I am tired after a busy week. In the afternoon, I meet my friends at a coffee shop and we talk. Sometimes, I visit my grandparents and we have a big dinner together.

questions.content:
Speaking — Part 2 - Describe a picture

Describe the picture.
questions.sampleAnswer: In the picture, I can see a bright and friendly cafe. There are five young students sitting together around a large wooden table. I think they are university students because they look young. They are studying together for their exams. On the table, there are some open books, notebooks, and two laptops. I also see some cups of coffee and a plate of snacks. Some students are writing notes in their books. One boy is pointing at a laptop screen and explaining something to his friend. They all look very focused but they also look relaxed and cheerful. Behind them, there are big windows with soft daylight coming in. It looks like a very nice place to study and they are enjoying their time.

questions.content:
Speaking — Part 2 - Describe a picture

Do you often study or work in a group? Why or why not?
questions.sampleAnswer: Yes, I often study in a group with my classmates. We usually meet at a quiet cafe or at the school library on weekends. I like studying in a group because we can help each other. When I do not understand a difficult lesson, my friends can explain it to me. It is also very fun because we can talk and drink coffee together.

questions.content:
Speaking — Part 2 - Describe a picture

What are the good things about studying with other people?
questions.sampleAnswer: There are many good things about studying with other people. First, we can share our ideas and learn new things from our friends. Second, we can solve hard homework questions faster when we work together. Finally, studying with friends is very motivating and exciting. When I see my friends working hard, I want to study hard too, so I do not feel lazy.

questions.content:
Speaking — Part 3 - Compare two pictures

Compare these two pictures.
questions.sampleAnswer: In the first picture, I can see two people walking in the countryside. The land has dry golden grass, and there are green trees and mountains far away. The sky is cloudy, and it looks very quiet and peaceful. In the second picture, a man and a woman are walking on a paved path next to a river in the city. There are modern buildings, street lights, and trees along the bank. It looks very lively and urban. The main difference is the place. The first photo shows a natural place with very few people, but the second photo shows a busy city area. I think walking in the countryside is good for relaxing, but walking in the city is great for meeting friends.

questions.content:
Speaking — Part 3 - Compare two pictures

Where do you like to go for a walk? Why?
questions.sampleAnswer: I really like to go for a walk in the local park near my house. It has many green trees and a small lake. I usually go there in the evening after my work. It is very quiet and peaceful, so I can relax and listen to music. Walking there helps me reduce stress and feel healthy.

questions.content:
Speaking — Part 3 - Compare two pictures

Why do you think walking is good for people?
questions.sampleAnswer: I think walking is very good for people because it is an easy exercise. It keeps our body strong and helps us lose weight. Also, walking outside is good for our mental health. We can enjoy the fresh air and forget about our problems. It is a cheap and simple way to stay healthy every day.

questions.content:
Speaking — Part 4 - Discuss an abstract topic

Describe a time when you helped someone. What happened, who did you help, what did you do, and how did you feel afterwards?
questions.sampleAnswer:
One time, I helped my neighbour, Mrs Lan, after she came home from the market. She is an older woman and she had two heavy bags of vegetables and fruit. I saw that she looked tired, so I asked if I could help her. She smiled and gave me the bags. I carried them from the gate to her kitchen on the third floor.

Then I put the food on the table and gave her some water. She thanked me many times. I stayed for ten minutes because she wanted to talk. She told me about her grandchildren, and I was happy to listen.

Afterwards, I felt warm and proud. It was only a small thing, but it made her day easier. I think helping people usually makes us feel useful and kinder. We can also feel closer to other people. Yes, it is important to help others because everybody has difficult days. If we help each other, our community can be friendlier and happier.
